clue.text: When trading stops for Charlie, falling behind schedule

parts.note: Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet
to fall behind schedule is to be losing time

explanation.surface: A trader called Charlie is running late as the market shuts.
explanation.walkthrough: CLOSING TIME is when a pub or shop shuts; here the trading is a shop's or market's, not stock trading.
explanation.definitionFit: Closing time is the hour at which a business stops trading for the day.

clue.text: Wraps up firms — one's lacking energy

parts.note: two firms, each CO, short for company

indicators.note: lacking says a letter is taken out of the word one's

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Companies wind up after one of them runs out of energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wraps up' reads as winding up a firm; it is the definition, a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To cocoon something is to wrap it up completely for protection.

clue.text: Had made king, but lacked credit

indicators.note: lacked says the abbreviation for credit goes missing

parts.note: a man made king is crowned
CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit

explanation.surface: A man was crowned but had no money to his name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacked' removes CR from CROWNED.
explanation.definitionFit: Owned means possessed, as had does in the sense of having something.

clue.text: Puzzled by equipment carried by United going astray

indicators.note: carried by says the piece for equipment sits inside the other
going astray says the letters of united wander out of order

parts.note: a rig is a set of equipment

explanation.surface: Fans are baffled when United's kit goes missing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going astray' makes INTUED from UNITED, and RIG is 'carried by' it.
explanation.definitionFit: Intrigued means curious and puzzled about something.

clue.text: Get hold of rent after taking heart from fight

indicators.note: after puts the piece for rent behind the one before it
the heart of a word is its middle letter

parts.note: a rent is a rip, a tear

explanation.surface: A landlord collects the rent after taking courage from a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rent' looks like money paid to a landlord; it is a tear.
explanation.definitionFit: To grip something is to take a firm hold of it.

clue.text: Hobby requiring financial stake

definitions.meaning: a hobby is a pastime that holds one's attention
a share in a business held as an investment

explanation.definitionFit: Interest means both a pursuit one enjoys and a financial share in a venture.

clue.text: Dodge concealed by upping weighted average

indicators.note: upping says the hidden letters are read backwards
concealed by says the letters lie inside the following words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A car is hidden behind a rising weighted average.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Dodge concealed' as the definition, but 'concealed by' is the hidden-word signal; 'Dodge' alone defines, and 'upping' turns the letters in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To dodge and to evade both mean to avoid something by cunning.

clue.text: Searched web for work — looked with intent

parts.note: something that works goes, functions
to ogle is to look at with desire

explanation.surface: A jobseeker browsed online for work, staring hard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for work' reads as job-hunting; 'for' links and 'work' gives GO.
explanation.definitionFit: To google is to search the internet using a search engine.

clue.text: Column inches initially put into medical application

indicators.note: put into says that letter is placed inside the other piece

parts.note: a plaster is applied to a wound

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of the word inches

explanation.surface: A newspaper column first puts inches into a medical treatment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Column inches' suggests newspaper space; 'Column' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilaster is a flat rectangular column projecting from a wall.

clue.text: Deceived in speech by arguments against squeeze

parts.note: the pros and cons: cons are arguments against

indicators.note: in speech says the word for deceived is taken as it is said, not spelt

parts.note: deceived means tricked

explanation.surface: Someone tricked by spoken arguments is put under pressure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in speech' means the word for deceived is taken by its sound; 'by' just joins.
explanation.definitionFit: To constrict is to squeeze or make narrower by pressure.

clue.text: Friend shot by friend in Paris

parts.note: ami is the French word for friend
a shot is a go, an attempt

explanation.surface: A friend is shot by a French friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Amigo is Spanish for friend, used informally in English for a pal.

clue.text: Road works have one new rule

indicators.note: works means the letters of road are worked into a new order

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Roadworks come with a new regulation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'works' reads as part of 'road works' but is the anagram signal, making ORDA from ROAD.
explanation.definitionFit: To ordain is to decree or rule officially that something shall be so.

clue.text: Rapid decline due to brawl after losing gold

indicators.note: after losing says a piece is taken out of the word for brawl

parts.note: a free-for-all is a brawl that anyone joins
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A sharp drop follows a fight in which the gold was lost.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brawl' gives the hyphenated free-for-all, and 'after losing' drops gold's heraldic name from its middle.
explanation.definitionFit: A free fall, outside parachuting, is a sudden steep decline, as in prices.

clue.text: Turn back inside to avoid contact with ruler

indicators.note: inside says one piece is put within the other

parts.note: to shun is to avoid contact with

indicators.note: back says the word for turn is read in reverse

parts.note: a turn is a go, as in a game

explanation.surface: Someone turns back indoors to keep away from a ruler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turn back' reads as retreating, but 'back' only reverses the word for turn before it goes 'inside'.
explanation.definitionFit: A shogun was a hereditary military ruler of feudal Japan.

clue.text: Shelled beans found in more mature plant

indicators.note: found in says those letters sit inside the other piece

parts.note: more mature means older

indicators.note: shelled strips off the outer letters of the word beans

explanation.surface: Shelled beans are discovered inside an older plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shelled' leaves EAN from BEANS, which goes into OLDER.
explanation.definitionFit: Oleander is a poisonous evergreen flowering shrub, a plant.

clue.text: Mixed trades so represented

indicators.note: represented is read as re-presented, the letters set out again in a new order

explanation.surface: A range of trades is shown in a varied way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'represented' rearranges TRADES SO.
explanation.definitionFit: Assorted means of various kinds, mixed together.

clue.text: Public knowledge covering area passed

indicators.note: covering says the two outer pieces wrap round the letter for area

parts.note: overt means open, public
ken is knowledge, as in beyond one's ken

explanation.surface: Public knowledge has spread over an area.
explanation.definitionFit: To be overtaken is to be passed by someone moving faster.

clue.text: Muscles needed to obtain beer?

definitions.meaning: well-defined abdominal muscles, a sculpted stomach
cans of beer sold in packs of six

explanation.surface: You need strong muscles to carry the beer home.
explanation.definitionFit: Six-packs are both toned stomach muscles and multipacks of six cans of beer.

clue.text: Money box or other container

parts.note: bread is slang for money
a bin is a box or receptacle

explanation.surface: A money box, or some other kind of container.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Money box' looks like one thing, a piggy bank, but splits in two; 'or other' links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A bread bin is a kitchen container in which loaves are kept.

clue.text: Withdraw defender (unconscious)

parts.note: a back is a defending player in football
out means knocked out, unconscious

explanation.surface: A defender is knocked out and pulls out.
explanation.definitionFit: To back out is to withdraw from an undertaking.

clue.text: Wishes to dispose of one 'super' house

indicators.note: to dispose of says a piece is thrown out of the word for wishes

parts.note: wishes means desires
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone wants to sell off a grand house.
explanation.walkthrough: DES RES is British estate-agent slang, short for desirable residence.
explanation.definitionFit: A des res is an estate agent's desirable residence, an attractive and superior home.

clue.text: Hang Southern States writer before break of day

parts.note: the States are the US
a pen is a writing instrument

indicators.note: the break of day is its first letter

explanation.surface: A Southern writer is executed before dawn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'break of day' reads as dawn but gives D.
explanation.definitionFit: To suspend something is to hang it from above.

clue.text: Tory to offer incentives with complete lack of respect

parts.note: Con is short for Conservative, a Tory in UK politics
to tempt is to entice with incentives

explanation.surface: A Conservative bribes voters with total disdain.
explanation.definitionFit: Contempt is the feeling that someone deserves no respect at all.

clue.text: Setter absorbed by objective to improve!

indicators.note: absorbed by says the setter's piece goes inside the other

parts.note: an end is an objective, a goal
the setter refers to themself as me

explanation.surface: The setter is intent on getting better.
explanation.definitionFit: To emend is to improve a text by correcting it.

clue.text: Emphasise the origin of safety lock

indicators.note: the origin of a word is its first letter

parts.note: a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: Underline where a safety lock comes from.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lock' suggests a security catch alongside 'safety'; it is a lock of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: To stress something is to emphasise it.

clue.text: Half of them are sick of such correspondence

indicators.note: half of the word them, its last two letters

parts.note: to ail is to be sick

explanation.surface: Half the people are sick of this kind of messaging.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Half of' takes the second half of THEM, EM.
explanation.definitionFit: Email is electronic correspondence, messages sent between computers.

clue.text: Rock back and look suggestively

indicators.note: back says the word for rock is reversed in this down clue

parts.note: to reel is to rock, to stagger

explanation.surface: A dancer rocks back and gives a knowing look.
explanation.definitionFit: To leer is to look at someone in a lecherous or suggestive way.

clue.text: Love to vote and look for growth

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like O
a cross, X, marks a vote on a ballot
to eye is to look at

explanation.surface: Someone eager to vote looks out for economic growth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'growth' sounds economic but means a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The oxeye daisy is a plant, and a plant is a growth in the botanical sense.

clue.text: Agree with partner — the game's over!

parts.note: two accounts that check agree with each other
a mate is a partner

explanation.surface: A player agrees with a partner that the match has ended.
explanation.definitionFit: Checkmate ends a chess game, so the exclamation announces the game is over.

clue.text: Unhappy mix, resulting in case of discord

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed inside the other
the case of a word is its outer letters
mix says the letters of resulting are stirred into another order

explanation.surface: An unhappy combination brings about a case of strife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mix' rearranges RESULTING into ISGRUNTLE, which goes 'in' DD, the 'case of discord'.
explanation.definitionFit: Disgruntled means discontented and unhappy, especially from a grievance.
